crafter.label: Crafter
crafter.description: Crafter block only: like a shaped recipe, but not in crafting tables or the inventory.

shapedTransform.label: Shaped Transform
shapedTransform.description: Crafting table in a pattern: one ingredient is the source item whose data the result keeps.

shapelessTransform.label: Shapeless Transform
shapelessTransform.description: Crafting table in any arrangement: one ingredient is the source item whose data the result keeps.

brewing.label: Brewing
brewing.description: Brewing stand: an ingredient turns the item in the bottle slot into this item.

smithingTransform.label: Smithing Upgrade
smithingTransform.description: Smithing table: upgrades the base item into this item, like netherite gear.

smithingTrim.label: Smithing Trim
smithingTrim.description: Smithing table: puts a trim pattern on the base item; this recipe has no result of its own.

transmute.label: Transmute
transmute.description: Crafting table: turns the input into this item and keeps the components you list.

anvil.label: Anvil
anvil.description: Anvil: combines the input with a material into this item or repairs it. Read by Nexo 1.30; not in the docs.

dye.label: Dye
dye.description: Crafting table: dyes the target item. Read by CraftEngine 26.9; not in the wiki.

input.label: Input
input.help: The furnace or stonecutter input, the bottle of a brewing stand, the item to transmute or repair, or the item to dye.

reagent.label: Ingredient
reagent.help: The item added at the top of the brewing stand.

template.label: Template
template.help: The smithing template in the first slot.

base.label: Base
base.help: The item that is upgraded or trimmed.

addition.label: Addition
addition.help: The material in the third slot, e.g. a netherite ingot or a trim material.

material.label: Material
material.help: The item combined with the input.

dye.label: Dye
dye.help: The dye or dye tag that colors the target.

permission.label: Permission a player needs to craft the recipe
permission.help: Players without it cannot use the recipe. Read by Nexo 1.30; not in the docs.

nexoGroup.label: Recipe book group
nexoGroup.help: Recipes with the same group share one slot in the recipe book. Read by Nexo 1.30; not in the docs.

nexoCraftingCategory.label: Recipe book tab
nexoCraftingCategory.help: The tab of the recipe book the recipe is listed in. Read by Nexo 1.30; not in the docs.

nexoCookingCategory.label: Recipe book tab
nexoCookingCategory.help: The tab of the furnace recipe book the recipe is listed in. Read by Nexo 1.30; not in the docs.

copyComponents.label: Copy the base item’s data to the result
copyComponents.help: Keeps names, lore, enchantments and other components of the base item.

trimPattern.label: Trim pattern put on the base item
trimPattern.help: A vanilla pattern or one from a data pack.

recipePreserve.label: Components the result keeps from the input

anvilCost.label: Experience levels the anvil takes
anvilCost.help: Costs at or above the anvil’s maximum (Recipes.anvil_max_repair_cost) show as too expensive outside creative mode. Read by Nexo 1.30; not in the docs.

anvilRepair.label: Durability the anvil restores
anvilRepair.help: When set, the anvil repairs the input by this amount instead of producing this item. Read by Nexo 1.30; not in the docs.

damage.label: Durability the item loses instead of being used up
damage.help: The ingredient stays in the grid and takes this much damage, like a knife.

preserve.label: Components the result keeps from this ingredient
preserve.help: E.g. damage, enchantments or custom_name; lets a recipe upgrade an item without wiping it.

craftingCategory.label: Recipe book tab
craftingCategory.help: The tab of the recipe book the recipe is listed in.

cookingCategory.label: Recipe book tab
cookingCategory.help: The tab of the furnace recipe book the recipe is listed in.

group.label: Recipe book group
group.help: Recipes with the same group in the same tab share one slot in the recipe book.

unlockOnIngredientObtained.label: Unlock when the player has the ingredients

unlockOnJoin.label: Unlock when the player joins
unlockOnJoin.help: Unlocks the recipe on join, whether or not the player has the ingredients.

showNotification.label: Show the unlock toast
showNotification.help: Shows a notification when the recipe is unlocked (on by default). Read by CraftEngine 26.9; not in the wiki.

alwaysRebuildResult.label: Build the result anew on every craft
alwaysRebuildResult.help: Off reuses the built result item. Read by CraftEngine 26.9; not in the wiki.

mergeComponents.label: Merge the source item’s components into the result
mergeComponents.help: On by default, like vanilla smithing.

transformProcessors.label: How the source item’s data reaches the result
transformProcessors.help: Apply data, merge enchantments, or keep custom data, components or tags of the source item.

postProcessors.label: Changes to the result item
postProcessors.help: Applies item data to the result, e.g. enchantments, so one recipe can produce a varied item.

pattern.label: Trim pattern put on the base item

conditions.label: Conditions a player must meet to use the recipe
conditions.help: All must hold. CraftEngine Premium only.

functions.label: Functions run when the recipe is crafted
functions.help: E.g. a command or a sound. CraftEngine Premium only.

visualResult.label: Result shown in the crafting grid instead of the real one
visualResult.help: Hides a random result until it is crafted (id, count, post_processors). CraftEngine Premium only.

disabledRecipes.label: Vanilla recipes Nexo disables
disabledRecipes.help: Recipe keys like minecraft:diamond_sword, written to recipes/disabled_recipes.yml for the whole project.

predicate.label: Checks the ingredient must pass
predicate.help: Require enchantments or an exact data component beyond the item ID.

source.label: Source item whose data the result keeps
source.help: Mark exactly one ingredient of a transform recipe.

applyData.label: Apply data
applyData.help: Applies item data to the combined item.

data.label: Item data to apply, like an item’s data section
data.help: Written as YAML, e.g. enchantment or lore.

mergeEnchantments.label: Merge enchantments
mergeEnchantments.help: Combines the enchantments of the result and the source item instead of picking one.

keepCustomData.label: Keep custom data
keepCustomData.help: Keeps paths of the custom_data component (1.20.5+).

applyData.label: Apply data
applyData.help: Applies item data to the result.

data.label: Item data to apply, like an item’s data section
data.help: Written as YAML, e.g. enchantment or lore.

enchantment.label: Enchantment
enchantment.help: The item needs at least these enchantment levels.

exact.label: Exact component
exact.help: The item needs this exact component value; copy it with /ce debug item-component.
